title: 10:16 fat ones leanness. Fatness represents temporal prosperity, goodness, and earthly blessings (Gen. 45:18; Deut. 31:20; Neh. 9:25; Prov. 13:4) leanness represents a lack of temporal or spiritual prosperity and earthly blessings and is caused by wickedness and slothfulness (17:4-5; Gen. 41:2-20). Thus in the passage cited above, the Lord replaces the world's fatness with leanness.
author: Tina M. Peterson
